title: Adding the external Postgres metadata plugin introduced FilterEngine.create_postgres_query(), which str.format()s DID-search filter keys and values from the REST API straight into raw SQL.

findings.explanation: All user-controlled keys are validated against a strict regex and all values are escaped before being interpolated into SQL strings. No raw user input reaches the query without sanitization.
The diff does not modify any authorization logic or endpoints; it only sanitizes input for SQL queries.
